categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/chain.h` to change the struct layout and memory footprint of `CBlockIndex`, the core in-memory block index structure.
categories.rationale: Reordering struct members eliminates 8 bytes of padding per `CBlockIndex`, saving ~8MB of RAM for ~1M blocks. While measurable and harmless, this is a minor memory optimization that has negligible impact on overall node memory ceilings and carries no special claim on scarce review attention.
